About

Built around a single idea: make it look like it means something.

Prasanna designs posters, key art and product campaigns that borrow the drama of the movie screen — bold type, deep colour, a single striking image — and puts it to work for brands, films and personal projects alike.

Every project moves through the same tools: Photoshop and Illustrator for the artwork, Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve when the work needs to move.
